test_cases.name: 429 retry with Retry-After
test_cases.input_setup: Mock 429 HTTP status with Retry-After: 2 header
test_cases.expected_result: Calculates delay >= 2.0s and classifies error as retryable

test_cases.name: Exponential backoff + jitter
test_cases.input_setup: Compute retry delays across multiple attempts without Retry-After header
test_cases.expected_result: Delays scale exponentially; jitter produces random spread
test_cases.evidence: Exponential progression: avg1=0.29s, avg2=0.78s, avg3=2.03s with jitter spread

test_cases.name: No retry on 400/401/403
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate retryability of HTTP 400, 401, 403, 404, 422 client errors
test_cases.expected_result: is_retryable returns False immediately; no retries attempted
test_cases.evidence: HTTP 400, 401, 403, 404, 422 all classified as non-retryable (zero retries)

test_cases.name: Key rotation removed
test_cases.input_setup: Recursive regex search for rotate_key and next_key across src/
test_cases.expected_result: Zero matches found across all production source files
test_cases.evidence: Zero matches for rotate_key or next_key in entire src/ directory

test_cases.name: 5xx + circuit breaker
test_cases.input_setup: Record repeated 503 errors against CircuitBreaker instance
test_cases.expected_result: Circuit transitions to OPEN; check_state raises CircuitBreakerOpenException
test_cases.evidence: Circuit breaker tripped after 3 consecutive 503 failures; short-circuits subsequent calls
